title: bug: prompt-cache-launcher and usage-launcher tests cut launch blocks that 447281cf wrapped in agent_git_exec / Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand, so 7 Linux and 21 Windows cases fail
description:
Regression from c4cd6dce's completion commit 447281cf (the agent Git-write guard), the same commit as task-5b0e90fe's descriptor regression. 447281cf prefixed every bash CLI launch with `agent_git_exec` (`            "$COMMAND_BIN" "${COMMAND_ARGV[@]}" \` became `            agent_git_exec "$COMMAND_BIN" "${COMMAND_ARGV[@]}" \`). It replaced the ps1 `& $Command` with `Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand`, and it added guard cleanup right after the launches.

scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs and scripts/tests/usage-launcher.test.mjs cut the REAL launch blocks out of each wrapper by text anchors and run them standalone with a fake CLI (mem:gotcha-launcher-test-extracts-codex-exec-blocks). Since 447281cf they fail four ways:
- prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs:349: the ps1 anchor `& $Command @CommandArgs @codexSeatArgs @codexExecOverrides exec --json ...` is gone ("missing real Codex stream invocation"). The sh anchor `            "$COMMAND_BIN" "${COMMAND_ARGV[@]}" \` (12-space indent) no longer matches ("missing boundaries").
- usage-launcher.test.mjs, Claude arms: an end anchor after the launch no longer matches. ps1: `\n        }\n    }\n\n    # Launch-failure classification`. sh: `\n    fi\n\n    stop_heartbeat_sidecar`. The assert reports this as "missing implementation boundary: <start marker>".
- usage-launcher.test.mjs, Codex arms: the cut block calls a guard function the harness never defines. sh gives CHILD_EXIT=127 (agent_git_exec not found). ps1 gives "The term 'Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand' is not recognized".

Evidence (2026-10-30, architect-bd1eb82d):
- Linux node v24.21.0, `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs scripts/tests/usage-launcher.test.mjs`:
  - HEAD fb47f668: 31 pass / 7 fail, all /bin/bash arms.
  - A `git archive 447281cf^ scripts docs/roles` snapshot: 38 pass / 0 fail.
- Native Windows node.exe at HEAD: 105 pass / 21 fail. That is the same 7 cases on each of powershell.exe, pwsh.exe and Git Bash.
- `git log 447281cf^..HEAD` touches moe-agent.{sh,ps1} and these two test files only in 447281cf.

Impact: .github/workflows/ci.yml:242 ("Test agent runtime discovery") runs both files on ubuntu, windows and macos, so every PR to main is red.

Fix direction: the tests follow the launcher, never the reverse.
- Re-anchor each cut on text that exists at HEAD.
- Run the guarded launch line as the launcher has it. Prefer giving each harness the launcher's own guard definitions, cut by anchor (agent_git_exec, and Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand plus the $script:AgentGitGuard state it reads). With no guard env they should pass straight through. Then the "preserves child exit" assertions also prove the guard keeps the child's exit code.
- Leave scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 alone.

Command, exit code and output tail go to complete_task.

The same two files exit 0 under native Windows node, with the powershell.exe, pwsh.exe and Git Bash engines all running: 0 failed, 0 skipped. Windows node.exe launched from WSL on a /mnt/d snapshot is acceptable evidence.

No harness strips the guard call from the block it cuts. Each one runs the launch line exactly as the launcher has it at HEAD, guard call included, and defines the guard function from the launcher's own source, not a test re-implementation.
scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1 are unchanged by this task; no assertion is weakened or deleted to get green.

implementationPlan.description:
Re-anchor scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs ('real Codex launch pipeline preserves Unicode, argv and child exit', about line 333).

The tests follow the launcher. Re-derive every anchor against HEAD at WORKING time: the architect validated these at a8ef4404, after c4cd6dce's 447281cf.

(1) Add, next to `between`, a helper that cuts the launcher's OWN guard from its source. It is not a re-implementation:
```
const guard = ext => ext === 'ps1'
  ? `$script:AgentGitGuard=$null\n${between(read('ps1'), 'function Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand {', 'function Remove-MoeAgentGitGuard')}`
  : `AGENT_GIT_GUARD_ENV=()\n${between(read('sh'), 'agent_git_exec() (', '\n)\n')}\n)\n`;
```
The empty guard state is the non-Git-project path the launcher itself takes, so the guard passes straight through. The 'CHILD_EXIT=23' assertion then also proves the guard keeps the child's exit code.

(2) ps1 branch:
- `at` = indexOf `Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand @CommandArgs @codexSeatArgs @codexExecOverrides exec --json -C "$projectPath" @codexSandboxArgs "$shortPrompt"`. It was `& $Command ...`. Keep the `                & {` lastIndexOf, the `            } else {` end and the 'missing real Codex stream invocation' assert.
- Insert `${guard('ps1')}` right before `${block}` in the script.

(3) sh branch:
- The start anchor becomes `'            agent_git_exec "$COMMAND_BIN" "${COMMAND_ARGV[@]}" \\\n'` (12 spaces, the exec branch's FIRST match; the TUI's identical line comes later). The end stays `'            set -e'`.
- Insert `${guard('sh')}` before `${block}`.

The cut keeps the guard call: never strip or replace it, and never edit scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}. Every existing assertion stays byte-identical.

Check with `env -u MOE_WORKER_ID node --test --test-name-pattern='real Codex launch pipeline' scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs`: it was 1 fail at HEAD, now 1 pass on /bin/bash.
implementationPlan.note: Added launcher-sourced guard helper; re-anchored ps1 and sh Codex exec cuts; the 'real Codex launch pipeline' test passes on /bin/bash. Dirty peer paths untouched.
Guard helper + Claude end anchors re-pointed; usage-launcher 9/9 on /bin/bash.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- Stripping `agent_git_exec` / `Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand` from the cut blocks, or defining a test-side stub: rejected by DoD3, and it would stop proving the guard keeps the child's exit code.
- A shared scripts/tests helper: allowed by the rail, but each file already carries its own between/read, and the cut is 3 lines, so stay inline.
- Setting a non-empty guard env so the fake asserts it: the description chooses no-env pass-through, so this is out of scope.
planningNotes.risks:
- c4cd6dce is still in REVIEW. If its QA reopens it (for example over the providerDescriptor drift, filed as task-5b0e90fe), the launch lines may move again. dependsOn holds WORKING until it is DONE; re-derive the anchors at HEAD then.
- The two scripts are wrapper-lane-sensitive: leave them untouched (task rail).
- The Windows run needs pwsh.exe on PATH (WindowsApps) and Git at C:/Program Files/Git.
- Never leave the /mnt/d scratch copy behind.
